Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Manner of Uploading Bids. Bids are required to be uploaded in G eM Portal as under Two Bid System consisting of Technical Bid and Co mmercial Bid:- (a) Technical Bid. Technical Bid consisting of the following a re required:- (i) Details of Firm / Vendor Details (as per Appendix -A) . (ii) Declaration regarding blacklisting / debarring from t aking part in bid (as per Appendix -B). (iii) The bidder should have a similar experience of runni ng such kind of laundry contract for minimum three year in any military training establishment preferably Sainik School / Military school/ RIMC (Copy of such agreement/ letters to b e attached as a proof). Any deviation against this condition will lead to rejection of bid. (iv) The minimum average annual financial turnover of R s. 12 Lakhs (Rupees Twelve Lakh Only) of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous fi nancial year duly attested by qualified chartered accountant in practice with UDIN number. (v) The school would not be able to provide any laundry building/ equipments to the bidders and the entire washing, ironing, delivery has to be done under the own arrangement s of the bidder. The bidder should give an undertaking to th is effect (The format of undertaking attached as Appendix C ). Bids shall be liable to be rejected without this undertakin g. (vi) Office Registration Certificate. The bidder should h ave his office registered in District Rewari (Haryana) with sh

op license of same place. (vii) IT returns for the last 02 years. (viii) A Copy of GST Certificate, a copy of PAN Card & Aad haar Card of the owner / Proprietor / firm. (ix) Firm Registration Certificate. (x) Cancelled Cheque. (xi) Copy of Bank Details. (xii) Acceptance of certificate of terms & conditions as per Appendix-C (b) Commercial Bid. The Commercial Bid consisting of Price Bid do cuments (as per GeM Modules, Rules and Regulations) as per Appendix - E. (c) Price Bid Format. Bidders are required to fill Price Bid Format f or monthly rates per cadet very clearly without any overwriting both in nu mber and words as per the format attached as Appendix - E correctly wi th full details, signature and stamp of the firm in all pages of the commerc ial bid. Incompletely filled form will be rejected out rightly. 2 . Geographic Presence (Office Registration Certificate) . The bidder should have his office registered in District Rewari (Haryana) wi th shop license of same place or else the bid is liable to be rejected. (N ote: The availability of proper Laundry area will also be inspected/ veri fied by BOO before finalization of tender, any deviation will result is ca ncellation of candidature and blacklist of the firm.) 3. Mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting. All bidders must attend the man datory pre-bid meeting to be held in the conference hall Sainik School Rewari. Failure to attend the Pre-Bid Meeting will result in the rejectio n of the bid and such bidders shall not be considered for further evalu ation in the bidding process. Bidders are advised to make necessary ar rangements to attend the meeting as per the schedule provided in the GeM portal.
